title: AMP body: session.init
description: body.type = 'session.init' — Propose a new session with capabilities.

proposed_capabilities.description: Capabilities the client wants to negotiate (e.g. messaging, tools, streaming)
proposed_capabilities.title: Proposed Capabilities

client_nonce.description: Random 256-bit hex string for replay protection. MUST be cryptographically random and globally unique. Use secrets.token_hex(32) or equivalent.
client_nonce.title: Client Nonce

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation ID to resume or bind to
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

previous_session_id.description: Previous session ID for session resumption
previous_session_id.title: Previous Session Id

client_ephemeral_key.description: Client ephemeral X25519 public key (32 bytes, base64url, no padding) for binding-key agreement. Required by servers that bind sessions (server_accept_init rejects an init without it).
client_ephemeral_key.title: Client Ephemeral Key
